mode: Behavioral scenarios; expected outcomes are rubrics, not executed MCP results

evals.prompt: AI Brain contains detailed pricing and FAQ data but the bot responds with a generic 'team must confirm' message.
evals.expected_output: The skill checks retrieval/grounding/fallback producing layer before adding more prompt text, verifies whether evidence was available to the turn, and hands backend fail-soft defects to AI debugger/incident repair.

evals.prompt: About says support is 24/7; FAQ says 9–5.
evals.expected_output: The skill flags a fact conflict, does not choose silently, blocks dependent customer-facing assertion and requests authoritative resolution.

evals.prompt: A Playbook says send the brochure after the user asks, but no active document is available.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports promise-without-material, does not claim file sharing works, and routes document readiness to knowledge manager.

evals.prompt: Sandbox answers correctly, so enable AI everywhere.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not infer production parity; it validates routing/toggles/channel behavior and acceptance evidence before readiness.

evals.prompt: The user asks to put passwords and internal prompts into AI Brain so the bot can use them.
evals.expected_output: The skill excludes secrets/internal control data from customer-facing knowledge and preserves confidentiality boundaries.
